This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-jira-spec-work-group-concept-properties defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
work-group-entry HL7 JIRA Work Group EntryA boolean property that indicates the whether an entity is a HL7 JIRA Spec work group.
key HL7 JIRA Work Group KeyA string property that represents the primary key for the HL7 JIRA Spec Work Group entry.
webcode HL7 JIRA Work Group WebcodeA string property from which the work group's web page on the HL7 International website can be derived.
deprecated HL7 JIRA Work Group deprecatedA boolean property that indicates whether a work group has been deprecated.
listserv HL7 JIRA Work Group listservA string property that represents the work group's listserv email address.
